summary: Verified the Plus-import bug fix in SaunaCalculator.jsx. Confirmed edit-mode + model-selected flow renders the three action buttons without white page or ReferenceError, and regression flows (new-order Sauna, Balia edit) are unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: SaunaCalculator.jsx is very large (~1945+ lines). Consider splitting into smaller focused components (models section, options, summary/actions) for maintainability - this crash happened because the huge import list on line 15 dropped an icon.

Suggest adding an ESLint rule (react/jsx-no-undef is default in create-react-app but the crash still shipped) or a pre-commit lint on both Sauna and Balia calculators; adding a smoke test that mounts edit mode + a model selection would prevent future regressions.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing sauna order WMS-D-6FCFA004 and existing balia order WMB-16-05-2026-183034.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix (Plus import in SaunaCalculator.jsx line 15) verified via UI. Screenshots show SaunaCalculator edit-mode summary with 3 buttons (Zaktualizuj KP i pobierz PDF, Utwórz nowe KP with + icon, Anuluj edycję). NEW-order sauna correctly shows only 'Zapisz i generuj PDF'. Balia edit mode still works with data-testids balia-save-generate-pdf-btn and balia-create-new-kp-btn. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors related to the fix. No 'Plus is not defined' anywhere.
rca of the issue: Root cause was correct: <Plus/> icon used in SaunaCalculator.jsx around line 1945 (edit-mode action buttons block) without being imported from lucide-react. Because it is a bare identifier reference inside JSX, evaluating that component threw ReferenceError which unmounted the entire React tree (white page). The tree only renders that button when both isEditMode is active AND a sauna model is selected, so the crash was hidden in most flows. Fix: adding `Plus` to the lucide-react named-imports on line 15 fully resolves the crash; no other code changes were needed.
